title: The Sail
subtitle: form: orthogonal, anchored at both ends
description: The solar sail, docked: `form: orthogonal`, with the line leaving
the sun at `fromAnchor: 90` and meeting the sail at `toAnchor: 270`
-- the angles a line leaves or meets a node at, zero east and
growing clockwise, and per-line only, because which rim a line
meets is a fact about its two ends and the chapter cannot know it.
